rationale: execution_progress_from_runtime_events() is a pure function: no I/O, no side effects, deterministic from event list input. Enables unit testing and composition in projection builder.

ExecutionProgressProjection data flows through existing DesktopProjection.progress_events array (type: array, no item schema at v1). Adding a JSON Schema creates maintenance burden. Pydantic model at code level provides type safety.

chunk_text from RuntimeOutputChunkEvent is NEVER included in the projection. Only aggregated byte counts and SHA256 hashes from terminal event appear. Raw chunks are ephemeral stream/chat pane data, not projection data.
Once a COMPLETION or FAILURE event is processed, its status overrides any non-terminal status. WARNING events after terminal are ignored. Defensive against out-of-order streams.

ProjectionIntegrity enforcement uses existing MISSING_RECEIPT, STALE_RECEIPT, AUTHORITY_UNBACKED codes. No new violation codes needed for execution progress — terminal event backing is assessed same as other projection data.
build_projection() gains an optional runtime_events parameter. When None (default), progress_events is empty or omitted. Backward compatible with existing callers.
ProgressTimeline widget exists in taxonomy but has no renderer. New ProgressTimelineWidget class following EvidenceRailWidget pattern: content-light, scrollable, status-driven. No raw output.
SessionPaneProjection has no execution progress linkage. ExecutionProgressProjection carries request_id and lease_id for future coordination store matching. UI composition deferred to post-P4d.
